pages.title: Oil Ocean Zone
pages.text: Oil Ocean Zone is the seventh level of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (Sega, 1992). Its graphics were made by the artist Craig Stitt, according to Sega Retro. Wikipedia says that the zone's artwork was redone before the game was finished.

pages.title: A slower tune
pages.text: In the Sonic Stadium Soundtrack Squad Review (2010), the reviewer JezMM counted Oil Ocean Zone among the slower tunes in Sonic the Hedgehog 2 that he found "either repetitive or just a bit dull".
